text.tspan: Plain numbers are Arduino pin numbers
Note: pins of the SAMD21 MINI follow the (discontinued) Arduino Zero M;
(pins 2 and 4 are swapped w.r.t. Arduino Zero) however it identifies as Arduino Zero.
SerialUSB refers to the serial monitor.
Serial1 refers to pins 0 and 1 (Serial refers to pins 30 and 31, which are not connected)
The LED that should be on pin 13 / PA17 is not soldered on the board. Use RX or TX led instead
